scope: Read-only review of repository previews; production and frozen UI unchanged

findings.detail: Frozen home HTML and ZIP referenced as external binaries; not included in GitHub checkpoint; cannot certify 1:1 equivalence from manifest alone.
Preview contains numerous navigation buttons, but inline script registers click handlers only for menu/drawer and player modal. Functional routing of Command Center buttons not established.
Portrait uses proportional scaling of a 1280px master rather than verified responsive reflow; usability on narrow Android portrait not certified.
Rally and Monte Carlo are standalone preview modules; no verified entry from frozen Command Center.
Game combat mechanics and real battle calibration remain unverified.

nextSteps: Preserve frozen master; obtain verifiable matching deploy artifact before touching shell
Implement route bindings on a separate non-production integration branch after identifying canonical master
Add functional navigation, access, portrait and fetch-error end-to-end tests
Validate all critical routes on Android portrait and desktop
Reconcile sample vs live data labels and permissions before release
